relationships.subject: Ibuprofen
relationships.evidence_quote: Ibuprofen and ketoprofen were more potent or efficacious in females than males in reducing mechanical allodynia and increasing weight-bearing on the CFA-injected paw

relationships.subject: SR144528
relationships.evidence_quote: Neither rimonabant nor SR144528 significantly altered ketoprofen effects in either sex

key_findings: NSAIDs were more antinociceptive in female than male CFA rats, while anti-edema effects favored males.
CB1/CB2 antagonists did not significantly attenuate celecoxib or ketoprofen effects.
